name: Protection Bonus
description: A general ward that makes the wearer harder to hit and harder to affect.

mechanics.text: While worn or carried, grants a bonus to AC and to saving throws. The plus-N tiers below assume a PERMANENT bonus (an always-on item) — confirmed real mismatch: Shield's own reaction-triggered, one-round +5 AC got costed against the plus-5 tier's own 40-point permanent-item price, landing at +1233% over its own target. The two temp-* tiers exist for exactly that shape (a spell's own short-lived bonus), priced against what a clean single-feature spell of that level actually needs, not against a permanent item's own value.
A sustained but temporary +2 bonus to AC (and saving throws if applicable) — lasts only as long as the spell/effect itself (typically requiring concentration), not permanent.
A single-round, reaction-triggered +5 bonus to AC — active only until the start of the target's next turn, not sustained or permanent.
